newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points on Friday as the market was hit by Intel Corp.'s warning that its second-quarter results would be below expectations.
At 9:39 a.m. EDT/1440 GMT, the Dow was off 55 points at 7,274, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
